name: Neuenrade (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Neuenrade (the Madonna on yellow above a chequy bar and a black cross).
history: Municipal flag of Neuenrade; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Neuenrade arms — Madonna, chequy bar and cross
